as_told.title: Jesse smells sulfur on his ranch visit; gas monitor reads nothing

plain: Jesse Michels says that when he visited Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reported strange happenings, around 2022, he smelled sulfur and felt he had to get out of there. He has told it himself on several episodes. In one he adds that a dark month followed the visit, and in another he says a gas monitor picked up nothing and jokingly blames a "dragon".
